notes: Biomass/hydrochar-derived CO2-activated carbons (Table S2: 95.6-97.9 wt% C). Gravimetric (Hiden XEMIS) H2 isotherms at -196 C to 100 bar; Tables 2-3 give uptakes at 100 bar and 5 bar, -196 C, with BET areas for the same samples. Uptakes are reported as total ('All H2 isotherms and reported uptake data are in terms of the total adsorption', converted from excess via He skeletal density and pore volume; main p. 3, Section 2.3). TPSA working capacities and -116 C isotherms are predicted, not measured. No statement that the H2 data were published before; not a review; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice.
